jobs.description_text:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

jobs.description_text:
The Thermal Engineer for Voyager Lunar Systems is responsible for supporting the design, build, test, and operation of thermal control system components for spacecraft, including lunar landers and surface power systems.

The position reports to the Propulsion and Thermal Systems Manager within the Engineering Department in Pittsburgh, PA. 

Job Responsibilities:

  • Support the design, integration, testing, and operation of thermal control systems for spacecraft, lunar landers, lunar surface power, lunar rovers, and other space systems
  • Support the thermal team by creating conceptual and detailed designs of spacecraft thermal system components and spacecraft hardware
  • Build and run component and spacecraft thermal models to guide design and operational decisions
  • Provide support in creating specifications for vendor supplied components, and support the thermal team in validating component performance
  • Provide support during spacecraft assembly in the cleanroom
  • Provide thermal team support for in-house TVAC (thermal vacuum chamber) testing of components, and support external thermal testing as required
  • Train in mission operations procedures and provide real time mission operations support

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or similar Engineering with 2 years of experience in thermal technologies, OR a Mast

The program manager will collaborate across teams to better understand and evaluate ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams, as well as potential ROI improvements as a result of workflow efficiencies and enhancements. Additionally, once established, the program manager will oversee daily EDS and reconciliation processes. This Manager will lead the design and implementation of Aledade’s end-to-end Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation program, including the creation of comprehensive program guides and Standard Operating Procedures. You will act as a cross-functional leader, evaluating the ROI of existing Alternate Submission Method (ASM) workstreams and driving workflow enhancements that directly improve data accuracy and operational efficiency. Once established, you will provide oversight of the daily EDS and reconciliation processes, ensuring that clinical encounter data—the lifeblood of value-based care—is accurately captured, validated, and submitted to payers and CMS with total integrity. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US.
